content: For per-tenant secrets (BYO SendGrid API keys), envelope encryption is the standard: encrypt each secret with a per-tenant Data Encryption Key (DEK), encrypt the DEK with a root Key Encryption Key (KEK) held in a managed KMS (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/age-based self-hosted for non-cloud). Avoid raw pgcrypto column encryption alone -- it keeps the master key reachable from the same DB compromise surface it's meant to protect against. Application-layer envelope encryption (Node crypto AES-256-GCM using a KMS-wrapped DEK) is preferred over DB-native pgcrypto for this threat model.
